purpose: Discovery comparison of physically motivated nonlinear hydraulic penetration scales after blind MECH2B falsified a universal initial-state D0=K0/C0 scaling.

literature.citation: Parlange (1975), sorptivity expressed through nonlinear soil-water diffusivity
literature.role: physical basis for a path-integrated diffusivity scale

literature.citation: Vrugt & Gao (2022), Vadose Zone Journal, DOI 10.1002/vzj2.20167
literature.role: sorptivity as a hydraulic super-parameter dependent on constitutive functions and initial moisture
diffusivity-form sorptivity S_D(theta0,theta1) with D(theta)=K(theta) dh/dtheta

discovery_only.warning: Both materials and all peak locations have already been exposed. MECH3A can select a candidate mechanism but cannot establish cross-material generality.

constitutive_authority.model: Mualem-van Genuchten with m=1-1/n and material-specific pore-connectivity lambda
constitutive_authority.hydraulic_diffusivity: D(theta)=K(theta)*dh/dtheta, positive on the unsaturated branch

pulse.target_state_rule: For each case solve the monotone unsaturated MvG relation K(theta_f)=r*K(theta_0), with r=1.5 for WET and r=0.5 for DRY. This is a forcing-equivalent unit-gradient state used only to define a constitutive path; it is not asserted to be the actual boundary water content.

candidate_scales.role: path scale less dominated by the largest diffusivity
sorptivity/desorptivity-like nonlinear path scale using the published Parlange diffusivity weighting

evaluation.global_constant_allowed: For scale comparison only, each candidate may have one global multiplicative constant c equal to the geometric mean of lambda over all 11 discovery cases. No material-, saturation-, or forcing-specific constants are allowed.
metrics: absolute difference between B01 and B14 mean ln(lambda)
absolute difference between WET and DRY mean ln(lambda)
evaluation.selection_rule: Among finite candidates, rank lexicographically by pooled ln(lambda) standard deviation, then material mean-log shift, then maximum absolute centered log residual.
evaluation.eligibility_for_blind_MECH3B: The selected nonlocal candidate must improve on LOCAL_D0 in both pooled log dispersion and absolute B01-vs-B14 mean-log shift. Otherwise close NO_SIMPLE_NONLINEAR_SCALE and do not promote a scale to blind validation.

blind_validation_firewall.next_materials: Not chosen from MECH3A outcomes. A separate MECH3B preregistration must freeze external materials and the selected formula before any new peak-location trajectory is generated.
